text: Heefareeɓe yedduɓe ummital wii: Nguurndam alah si wonah nguurndam amen aduna ɗam, nguurndam alah caggal ɗaam, njiirle na maaya nduttataaka, jiirle kadi nguura, alah ko warata min si wonah lomtandirde jemma e nyalawma, ɓe ngalah ganndal koɓe njeddi ko ummital, ɓe ngonah si wonah sikkooɓe, te sikke nafatah goonga hay ndiga;
